Team Assignment for Customer Support
On: tickets can be assigned to the department's teams, by an agent or by a rule, and every assignment picker shows a Teams tab. Off: only agents can be chosen. A team ticket waits in the team queue until a member picks it up or a Round Robin rule whose pool is that team assigns it.
